text: dsh-desktop 是一个将 DSH Web UI 包装为 Electron 桌面应用的 DSH bundle。它通过 Cordis patch 注册命令行启动 provider 和桌面 runner；启动时优先使用 --url 指定的地址，其次复用已绑定的本地 Web 服务，没有可用服务时尝试启动 dsh web。桌面窗口带有跟随 DSH 主题变化的自定义标题栏和系统托盘，可最小化、最大化、隐藏到托盘、重新显示窗口、在浏览器打开 Web UI 或退出。Electron 可从配置路径、模块解析结果或 PATH 查找；使用需要本机可用的 Electron。

dsh-desktop wraps DSH Web UI in an Electron app. Its Cordis patch registers startup and runner plugins, loads an explicit URL or local Web server, and can start dsh web if needed. A theme-aware title bar and system tray support hiding, restoring, and quitting. Electron must be available locally.

dsh-desktop 的功能「Electron 桌面窗口」：启动时按显式 URL、本地 Web 服务地址的顺序选择页面；没有现成服务时尝试启动 dsh web，再启动 Electron 窗口。
dsh-desktop 的功能「系统托盘」：托盘菜单可显示主窗口、在浏览器打开 Web UI 或退出；窗口关闭时隐藏到托盘，托盘不可用时按平台行为退出。
dsh-desktop 的功能「主题标题栏和窗口控制」：预加载代码注入 DSH 风格标题栏并读取设计 token 随主题重绘；标题栏按钮可最小化、最大化或关闭窗口。

- URL 解析优先级：`--url` > Web Server 端口 > 自动启动 `dsh web`

A dsh desktop bundle: an Electron shell over the dsh Web UI, with a system tray and a dsh-styled custom title bar. Installed as an out-of-tree plugin — it changes no dsh source and keeps Electron out of the dsh dependency tree.

@ahikl/dsh-desktop README · What it is：A **bundle** (it declares `dsh.bundle.patch`): when added to a profile, it lays the desktop surface over `dsh-web-app`. It mounts two rows — `desktop-startup` (parses the `desktop` command) and `desktop-runner` (spawns Electron once the tree settles).

@ahikl/dsh-desktop README · What it is：The Electron window is frameless with a custom title bar that reads the dsh design tokens (`--dsw-alias-*`), so it follows the current light/dark theme and re-paints on theme switches. Closing the window hides it to the system tray; the tray menu shows the window, opens the Web UI in a browser, or quits.

@ahikl/dsh-desktop README · Compatibility：Built against dsh `0.1.0-rc.5`. The dsh framework packages are `peerDependencies`: they resolve from the receiver's dsh installation at runtime, never from this package's own install.
@ahikl/dsh-desktop README · from npm (once published)：dsh plugin --profile desktop add @ahikl/dsh-desktop @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app
@ahikl/dsh-desktop README · or straight from git：dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:ahikl/dsh-desktop @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app

@ahikl/dsh-desktop README · Electron is a per-profile runtime requirement (platform binary, not bundled)：dsh plugin --profile desktop add electron

@ahikl/dsh-desktop README · Develop and build：Inside the dsh monorepo checkout, the `tsconfig.json` `paths` map the framework packages to source, so the following run without published copies:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck   # tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
pnpm run test        # vitest run (pure unit tests in tests/)
pnpm run build       # tsc emits lib/types, tsdown bundles lib/{index,startup}.js

`lib/` is gitignored; publish runs `build` via `prepack`.

Before publishing, drop the `paths` block in `tsconfig.json` and add the framework packages as `devDependencies` with their real published versions (they are currently `@deepseek-ai/*` pre-release packages).
